publicDomain.description: Trusted DNS suffix for load_balancer and web endpoints; empty disables both domain modes. Web requires external wildcard DNS/TLS and the shared Gateway.

workloadHelperImage.description: Optional separate workload helper image; empty follows the provider image.

snapshotClass.description: Empty disables backups. Must identify a durable Longhorn CSI type: bak VolumeSnapshotClass, not a local snapshot class.
